Partners.title: We build joint IT projects and applied development work with real outcomes
Partners.intro: If you have an idea, product, challenge, research direction, or educational initiative that needs a strong technical partner, let’s discuss how to make it happen together. We are not interested in formal networking for its own sake. We prefer practical collaboration, useful experiments, and concrete results.

Advertising.title: Place advertising inside GrapeLab websites, apps, and digital products
Advertising.intro: If your audience lives in digital products, we can place advertising inside GrapeLab-owned platforms: websites, mobile apps, game mechanics, and custom product surfaces. We shape the placement model around the task, context, and product flow instead of forcing a generic media package.

heroTags.products: Websites, apps, games, and special projects

stats.inventoryDescription: Advertising inside products we design and maintain ourselves, without extra intermediaries or fragmented approvals.
stats.modelsValue: From banners to deep product integrations
stats.modelsDescription: We choose the placement format according to context: standard display blocks, special placements, native inserts, or partnership mechanics.
stats.supportValue: Packaging, creative adaptation, and launch support
stats.supportDescription: If needed, we help structure the offer, adapt the message to the product environment, and prepare a launch scenario that fits the platform.

formats.title: Advertising formats aligned with product logic and audience behavior
formats.description: We are not limited to one ad slot. We choose the touchpoint where the integration feels natural and does not break the user experience.

websites.title: Websites and web services
websites.description: Banner zones, native inserts, partner cards, and placements inside content or service-oriented sections.

apps.title: Mobile applications
apps.description: Placements inside app screens, branded screens, CTA blocks, partner cards, and scenario-based integrations.

games.title: Games and gamified mechanics
games.description: Brand integration into gameplay, reward-based mechanics, branded levels, and narrative touchpoints.

special.title: Special projects and custom placements
special.description: When a standard slot is too limited, we design a dedicated mechanic or interface around the partner objective.

models.title: We structure the placement model around the goal, not only the format
models.description: A campaign can start with a fixed placement, a performance-oriented model, or a deeper product integration. Terms depend on the product, the audience, and the interaction scenario.

native.title: Native integration
native.description: We embed the brand message into the user journey so it feels like part of the product instead of an unrelated banner.

fixed.title: Fixed placement
fixed.description: Useful when you need a clear position, a fixed launch period, and stable visibility on a selected surface.

performance.title: Result-oriented model
performance.description: For some campaigns we can discuss conditions tied to reach, actions, or another measurable business objective.

partnership.title: Partnership setup
partnership.description: If the task requires a longer cycle, we can shape a joint mechanic that includes both product and marketing logic.

advantages.title: We are not only the placement owner, we are also the product team
advantages.description: Because we build and maintain these digital products ourselves, we can discuss the whole interaction scenario instead of just selling a banner slot.

audience.title: Contextual audience
audience.description: The advertising appears inside a digital environment where users are already engaged with a task, flow, or content.

control.title: Flexible integration depth
control.description: We can discuss not only existing slots, but also interface changes, display logic, and deeper integration points.

production.title: Product and technical team nearby
production.description: If needed, we can quickly adapt the placement, create a new mechanic, and align implementation without a long chain of contractors.

reporting.title: Clear communication
reporting.description: We define the format, terms, touchpoints, and evaluation logic before launch so expectations stay aligned.

process.title: A practical workflow without unnecessary bureaucracy
process.description: We start from the task and the product context, then propose a realistic placement model instead of sending a generic media kit.

inventory.title: Choose the product and touchpoints
inventory.description: We identify the product and the user scenario where the integration will feel relevant and effective.

proposal.title: Define the format and terms
proposal.description: We lock the placement type, campaign scope, material requirements, timing, and how the result will be evaluated.

launch.title: Launch and support
launch.description: We prepare the integration, validate the product flow, launch the placement, and stay in touch during the campaign.

finalCta.title: Let’s discuss the brand, audience, and campaign goals
finalCta.description: After that, we will suggest the right product, integration format, and placement scenario.

Community.title: An open IT community for those who want to grow, connect, and build things together
Community.intro1: We are building a community that grew from a student environment but is open to everyone who cares about technology, practice, knowledge sharing, and joint initiatives.
Community.intro2: This is a space to find like-minded people, join projects, share knowledge, and be part of a living professional environment.

heroSide.label: What it gives
heroSide.note: A living community, not a formal contact

about.title: Not just a community, but an environment for growth through participation
about.text: We want a living environment to form around GrapeLab where people can meet, discuss ideas, join initiatives, launch collaborative projects, and grow not alone but alongside others.
about.manifesto: Growth begins where there are people, ideas, practice, and room to participate
about.pillar1: an entry point into a strong community
about.pillar4: the opportunity to grow with others

who.title: Who can become part of the community
who.text: We do not limit the community to students only. We are interested in people with different levels of experience and roles, as long as they care about growth, technology, knowledge sharing, and participation in a living environment.

benefits.title: What participation in the community gives you
benefits.item1: a strong circle and new connections
benefits.item3: involvement in initiatives and collaborative projects
benefits.item5: the opportunity to find a team or allies
benefits.item6: growth through practice, not just theory

join.title: How to get involved
join.text: You do not need to arrive with a finished project or extensive experience. There are many ways to participate — depending on your interest, level, and readiness to engage.
join.role5: as an expert ready to share knowledge
join.role6: as an organizer or activity initiator
join.role7: as a partner who wants to support the environment

why.title: Why this matters to us
why.text1: GrapeLab is not only about development and projects. We care about building an environment where connections, ideas, practice, joint initiatives, and growth opportunities emerge for people who are drawn to technology and moving forward.
why.text2: We want a living community to exist alongside the studio — one where you can not just observe, but participate, grow, and be part of something bigger.

finalCta.title: Want to become part of the GrapeLab community?
finalCta.text: Visit the community website to learn more, explore participation formats, join community life, and find your place in this environment.
